dct_description_sm: Financial services: banks, ATMs, post offices, money transfer agents, and microfinance branches tagged via `amenity`. Useful for financial-inclusion mapping, cash-distribution planning, and economic analysis. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity) - Part of the [country exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
